description: This file is a Perl script used for downloading files in the OpenWrt build system, handling multiple mirror sources and verifying file hashes.

methods.name: localmirrors
methods.description: Reads local mirror URLs from configuration files and environment variables.

methods.name: projectsmirrors
methods.description: Reads project-specific mirror URLs from a JSON file and appends them to the mirrors list.

methods.name: which
methods.description: Checks if a given program is available in the system's PATH.

methods.name: hash_cmd
methods.description: Determines the appropriate hash command (md5 or sha256) based on the checksum length.

methods.name: tool_present
methods.description: Checks whether a specific download tool (curl, wget, aria2c) is available.

methods.name: select_tool
methods.description: Selects the most suitable download tool based on what's available.

methods.name: download_cmd
methods.description: Constructs the command line to download files using the selected tool.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Performs the download from a mirror, handles local files, verifies checksum, and manages filenames.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes temporary files used during download.
